gs-desc.Text: A proof-of-concept polearm with a separate integrated bolt weapon profile. Provides a melee strike and Bolt Shot.

gs-hidden-desc.Text: Internal ranged profile used by Guardian Spear Bolt Shot.

gs-hidden-flavor.Text: Not intended for inventory or loot.

gs-shot-desc.Text: Fire the Guardian Spear's integrated bolter using its hidden ranged weapon profile.
